effect.name: Hologram (Switch)
effect.description: The shader creates a hologram effect where, for every third pixel in a given texCoord, a color from a separate channel is displayed.
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo's Hologram (Switch) Shader | 2026.09.05 */
parameter.description: The shader creates a hologram effect where, for every third pixel in a given texCoord, a color from a separate channel is displayed.

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable determines which color will be the basis for modification. Set to 0 means it will be the texture of the object and set to 1 it will be the background.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.
